tiles.label: DRIVER CARRY
tiles.sub: GTS2 Steadfast, best drive (277.2 carry / 288.9 total)

sections.title: HIITS  ·  LEVEL 3, WEEK 4
rows: Level 3, week 5: 5 light, 5 medium and 5 heavy, twice, then 5+ light light, then 5+ gamer drives

groups.name: GTS2 + Steadfast
rows: Right: 22 of 44 full swings 10+ yards right, 12 left

Play 262 carry as your number, since your good ones land 262 to 272. You miss right more than left, so aim at the left edge of the fairway and let the miss work back to the middle. Don't try to squeeze out the 272 over trouble.

Feel the load go into your right hip on the way back, with the left hip staying quiet instead of popping up. That gives you more room to hit up on it, since you're only at 1.3 up and the spin is high at 3,287.

groups.name: GTS2 + Tensei
rows: Right: 10 of 22 full swings 10+ yards right, 8 left

Plan on 265 carry, with 262 to 275 as your range. The misses are about even left and right, so aim at the middle of the fairway. Take the 3-wood or a smooth swing on tight holes until the good swings show up more often.
Keep the front shoulder pointing behind the ball a beat longer in transition so it doesn't fly open. Your strike is already good at 2.3 up, so the shoulder is what's costing you the clean ones.

groups.name: 5 Iron
rows: Right: 11 of 26 full swings 10+ yards right, 3 left

Play 205 carry and think of 198 as your short side. Aim at the middle of the green, because your misses go right, so keep trouble off the right side. If you need more than 205, take a longer club instead of forcing it.
Keep the same ball position and strike you had today, and feel the chest turn through a little earlier. That should cut the misses to the right, which showed up 11 times against 3 left.

groups.name: 9 Iron
rows: Left: 4 of 19 full swings 10+ yards left, 3 right

Play 149 carry, and use 140 as your floor when a front pin or a hazard is short. Into the wind or uphill, take one more club and swing 75 to 80 percent. That swing was good today and you control it better.
Hold the right wrist bent into impact instead of throwing the right hand at the ball. That keeps the hands ahead and steepens the strike, which is shallow at -2.7 and costs you spin at 6,605.

groups.name: 48°
rows: Right: 2 of 13 full swings 10+ yards right, 0 left

Play 121 carry for a full swing, with 116 as the safe number when short is trouble. You're very straight with it, so aim at the middle of the green and don't chase the pin. If you're between numbers, take an easier swing with the 48 instead of pressing.
Set the ball one ball back of center with your hands slightly ahead, and hold that lean through impact. It should steepen the strike from -4.4 and add spin, which is 8,714.

groups.name: NEXT SESSION
rows: Keep the front shoulder pointing behind the ball a beat longer through transition on every full swing, so it doesn't fly open.

sections.title: HIITS  ·  LEVEL 3, WEEK 5
rows: Level 4, week 6: 3 sets of 4 light, 4 medium and 4 heavy, then 8 to 16 gamer drives

groups.name: GTS2 + Steadfast Lite
rows: Right: 12 of 30 full swings 10+ yards right, 7 left

Plan on 249 carry and let anything past that be a bonus. This shaft missed right more than left, so aim down the left-center of the fairway and take the right rough out of play. On tight holes where you need the fairway, go with the other shaft.

Tee it half an inch higher and keep your head behind the ball at contact. Your head-in-front feel works for the irons, but with driver it keeps you hitting down. Keep the front shoulder behind the ball in the backswing and stay there through impact.

groups.name: GTS2 + Tensei
rows: Both ways: 11 of 29 full swings 10+ yards right, 11 left

Play 254 carry and you will rarely be short of it. Misses went both ways evenly, so aim at the middle of the fairway and let the hole shape decide. This is the shaft I would carry when the fairway is tight.
Tee it a bit higher and play the ball off your front heel. Feel your weight in the arch of the right foot, and keep the right ear back at impact so you can hit up on it instead of down.

groups.name: 4 Iron
rows: Right: 7 of 20 full swings 10+ yards right, 5 left

Trust 189 carry, not the best one. Use it off the tee on tight par 4s or for long par 3s when the green is open in front. If the pin is tucked or the carry is over water at 200, take the extra club or lay up. Aim for the fat part of the green.

Set your hands even with the ball at address instead of ahead of it, and keep the right elbow and forearm square to the ball through impact. That keeps the loft on the club so the ball launches higher and lands softer.

groups.name: 8 Iron
rows: Right: 6 of 22 full swings 10+ yards right, 3 left

Play 156 carry as your number. If the pin is 165 or more, take a 7 and make a smooth swing instead of forcing the 8. Aim at the middle of the green, and on a short-sided pin pick the club that keeps you pin-high or just past it.

Rotate harder through the ball. Open the left chest and keep length in the ribs, with your head in front and contact at the right ear. That speeds up the club and steepens the strike, so you take the ball first and then turf.

groups.name: NEXT SESSION
rows: Check your grip before every swing, with the left wrist into ulnar deviation and light pressure, then let the backswing and rotation follow from that.

sections.title: HIITS  ·  LEVEL 3, WEEK 4
rows: Level 3, week 5: 2 sets of 5 light, 5 medium and 5 heavy, then 8 to 16 gamer drives

groups.name: GTS2 + Tensei
rows: Left: 18 of 32 full swings 10+ yards left, 4 right
Play it as a 251 to 263 carry and trust 251 when there is trouble. You missed left 18 times and right 4, so aim down the right half and let a small miss stay in the fairway.

Tee it half a ball higher and play it a touch more forward, then feel the swing going out to the right with your hands inside. You're hitting down 1.5 degrees on a driver, and that will help you hit up on it and cut the left miss.

groups.name: GT3 + Steadfast
rows: Right: 4 of 8 full swings 10+ yards right, 3 left
Play it as a 251 to 267 carry and trust 260 as your number. Misses were even left and right, so aim at the middle of the fairway and take the side with less trouble.
Tee it higher and move the ball up off your left heel, with your chest staying a little behind it. Spin is high at 3428 and you're only hitting up 0.9, so this should drop the spin and add carry.

groups.name: 4 Iron
rows: Both ways: 8 of 26 full swings 10+ yards right, 8 left
Play it as a 204 to 215 carry and trust 204 with trouble short. Aim at the middle of the green, and when you need more than 215, club up or take a hybrid. Never force the 4 iron.
Swing at 80 percent and keep your right elbow the same distance from your belly button on the way back. The out-to-in came from swinging too hard, and it settled once you eased off.

groups.name: 7 Iron
rows: Left: 6 of 28 full swings 10+ yards left, 5 right
Play it as a 183 carry and trust 170 into wind or when you're not sure. Aim at the middle of the green, since the misses were even both sides.

Keep the right elbow the same distance from your belly button on the way back and throw the right hand through. Hit a few easy ones to settle the path first. Early balls were off, and the last 15 to 20 were much better.

groups.name: 9 Iron
rows: Right: 6 of 30 full swings 10+ yards right, 2 left
Play it as a 150 carry and trust 143 when short is safe. You missed right 6 times and left twice, so favor the left-center of the green and keep the right edge out of play.
Hold the left wrist flexed and keep the right hand on top of the club through impact, so the clubhead doesn't fall behind you. That should close the open face and bring the right miss in.

groups.name: 52°
rows: Both ways: 1 of 14 full swings 10+ yards right, 1 left
Play it as a 109 to 116 carry. Aim at the middle of the green and let it land on the fat part. From a number between those, take the shorter one with trouble long. This club saves you strokes.
Set up with your left cubital region facing the ball and hold the grip light between the thumb and middle finger. Keep the hands a touch ahead, so you hit down a little more on the ball.

groups.name: NEXT SESSION
rows: Keep your right elbow the same distance from your belly button through the takeaway and turn, and swing at 80 percent. Today's best swings came when you did this and stayed in control.

sections.title: HIITS  ·  LEVEL 2, WEEK 3
rows: Move up to Level 3, week 1, and keep the light, medium and heavy set structure.
Average 113.5 on the light sets and 111 on the heavy, up from 112.6 and 109.8, then carry that to the gamer drive.

groups.name: Driver
rows: Left: 9 of 16 full swings 10+ yards left, 3 right

Play it 252 carry on a tight hole, 264 when you need the number. Misses went left, so aim at the right-center of the fairway and let it work back. Club down to a 3-wood if the hole pinches inside 250.
Tee it half an inch higher and move the ball a touch forward to get the angle of attack from 1.7 up toward 3.

groups.name: GTS2 + Steadfast
rows: Right: 7 of 11 full swings 10+ yards right, 0 left
Trust 244 to 252 carry. Misses went right with high spin, so favor the left side of the fairway and don't bring the right trouble into play. Pick another driver on a hole that is tight right.
Tee it higher and feel the club moving up through the ball to bring that 3757 spin down.

groups.name: GTS2 + Steadfast Lite
rows: Left: 4 of 7 full swings 10+ yards left, 3 right
Plan on 255 to 261 carry. Misses split both ways, so aim center and take the widest part of the fairway. Good option when you need to hit a number.
Move the ball forward half a ball width and tee it a bit higher to lift the angle of attack from 1.3.

groups.name: GTS2 + Tensei
rows: Left: 7 of 14 full swings 10+ yards left, 4 right
Plan on 254 carry, not the 274 best case. Misses leaned left, so aim right of center. Leave it in the bag on a hole with water or trouble left.
Feel a smooth, balanced swing at about 90 percent, since only 6 of 14 were good.

groups.name: GT3 + Steadfast
rows: Right: 4 of 7 full swings 10+ yards right, 3 left
Most reliable carry of the group at 263 to 268. Aim center and use it when you need one fairway.
Keep the same ball position and tee height, and feel the handle stay level with the ball at impact to trim launch from 17.4.

groups.name: 6 Iron
rows: Left: 12 of 26 full swings 10+ yards left, 5 right

Plan on 190 carry and don't count on 198. Misses went left, so aim at the right-center of the green. Club down to a 7 when the pin is front, and take the longer club when the green is firm and you can run it on.
Move the ball half a ball back and feel the strike land on the turf just after the ball to steepen from -2.6 toward -3.7.

groups.name: 8 Iron
rows: Right: 2 of 12 full swings 10+ yards right, 1 left
Play 166 carry. Misses were few and even, so aim at the middle of the green. Take one less club when the pin is short and the green is soft.
Set the ball center and the hands slightly ahead, then hold that shaft lean through impact.

groups.name: 48°
rows: Right: 4 of 23 full swings 10+ yards right, 1 left
Full 48 is 120 carry. Inside that, take a shorter swing rather than forcing it to 127. Misses went right, so aim at the left-center of the green and take the middle of the green over a tucked pin.
Set 60 percent of your weight on the lead foot and keep it there through impact to get the strike steeper.

groups.name: NEXT SESSION
rows: Set 60 percent of your weight on the lead foot on every iron and wedge and hold it through impact, since wedges inside 100 are costing you the most strokes.
